intro: Your order and booking payments, as recorded by the server.
empty: No payments were found for this account.
error: Payments could not be checked. Please refresh to try again.
unavailable: This payment is unavailable to this account.
offline: You are offline. Any details shown are the last server-confirmed records. Reconnect to refresh or print a receipt.
unsettled: This record is not a settled payment receipt. Its current status is shown below.
settled: The server confirms this payment is held or released. This receipt shows the current payment record.
